name: @playliquid/avatar-runtime
description: PlayLiquid GameOS Avatar Runtime (PL-026). Avatar = Body + Intelligence: composes avatar definitions whose body/sensors/actuators/memory/intelligence are separately versioned sub-records (skills referenced as packages — no skill engine), drives sensor input and actuator output ports, and routes EVERY action through the Capability Broker so avatar-agent intents become broker-mediated canonical commands per @playliquid/runtime-contracts (lock rules 13/14). Ports are pure interfaces with in-memory fakes; the interactive/simulation runtimes host execution — this package builds no second kernel. Host restriction of avatar capabilities follows the frozen game-contracts R5 vocabulary; runtime authority is broker grants (R20 least privilege). No IO, no timers, no globals.
